scope: Independent visual annotations of the new proportions-v2 runtime input before color correction. Sparse material witnesses are checks; the cap boundary is an explicit algorithm input. No pose or color approval is implied.

calibration.measurement: Per-channel median of the fixed 3x3 patch. Visually selected interior of the near calf, away from outline, calf shadow and drawn hair marks.

cap.coordinate_convention: Protect pixel (x,y) above the linearly interpolated boundary when y+0.5 < boundary(x+0.5). Raster is row-major uint8, 255 protected and 0 elsewhere.
cap.method: Reinspected the new raw and exported v2 cap. The visible crown, gold band and brim fit above this sloped boundary, which includes a narrow hair/ink margin. It agrees with the earlier018 outline but is bound to and checked against this new input; no old pixel mask or material expectations are reused.
cap.rejected_alternative: Protecting all top22 rows would cover visible ear/temple skin. For example new input pixel[18,20] is RGBA[255,149,91,254] and[18,21] is[255,156,95,254]. Both remain outside this cap polygon.

limitations: These seven points and three 3x3 regions do not exhaustively segment every material. The cap boundary is a conservative visual exclusion; it is not independent proof of the color classifier. Skin targets and correction functions are chosen and verified separately.
